title: 9 links that explain today's late biotech fireworks: SELLAS +156% onPhase 3 data, Greenwich +36%. Real breakthroughs or lottery tickets?
author: tickeron_community
selftext:
Biotech kept popping into the afternoon. SELLAS jumped about 156% on  
Phase 3 data showing its cancer vaccine cut the risk of death by 41%,  
Greenwich LifeSciences rose 36% after conference abstracts were  
accepted, and Lycia gained 8.8% as four banks launched coverage. Some  
of today's movers had no news at all. Can you tell which?  
  
Here is the rundown, drawn from today's write-ups.  
  
\*\*1. SELLAS Life Sciences Group (SLS)\*\* — SLS jumped +155.56% to  
$19.09 from Monday's $7.47 close, trading throughout the regular  
session after opening at $24.11. The catalyst was positive topline  
Phase 3 REGAL data: cancer vaccine galinpepimut-S cut the risk of  
death by 41% in second-remission AML, with median overall survival of  
24.0 months versus 14.7 months (HR 0.59, p=0.035).  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-sellas-life-sciences-group-sls-stock-up-157-03-today-39901/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-sellas-life-sciences-group-sls-stock-up-157-03-today-39901/)  
  
\*\*2. Greenwich LifeSciences (GLSI)\*\* — GLSI jumped from Monday's close  
of $13.76 to $18.72, a +36.05% move that built through Tuesday's  
regular session and accelerated into the final hour. The catalyst:  
Greenwich announced that two FLAMINGO-01 abstracts and matching  
posters were accepted for the 2026 San Antonio Breast Cancer  
Symposium, to be presented December 9; the release carried no new  
trial data.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-greenwich-lifesciences-glsi-stock-up-36-05-today-39902/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-greenwich-lifesciences-glsi-stock-up-36-05-today-39902/)  
  
\*\*3. Latigo Biotherapeutics (LTGO)\*\* — LTGO jumped +11.19% to $14.01  
from the prior close of $12.60, with the advance taking place during  
Tuesday's regular session. No verified news or fundamental catalyst  
found.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-latigo-biotherapeutics-ltgo-stock-up-11-19-today-39953/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-latigo-biotherapeutics-ltgo-stock-up-11-19-today-39953/)  
  
\*\*4. Apnimed (APMD)\*\* — Apnimed (APMD) jumped +9.15%, climbing from  
the previous close of $16.28 to $17.77 during regular Nasdaq trading  
on Nov 17, reversing part of the prior session's -3.78% post-earnings  
decline. No verified news or fundamental catalyst found — BofA's Nov  
17 trim of its target to $40 from $41, with Buy maintained, is too  
small to explain a +9% move; the rise is likely post-earnings  
dip-buying in a thinly...  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-apnimed-inc-apmd-stock-up-9-15-today-39961/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-apnimed-inc-apmd-stock-up-9-15-today-39961/)  
  
\*\*5. Lycia Therapeutics (LYCA)\*\* — LYCA jumped from a $28.61 close to  
$31.14, a gain of +8.84%, with the move taking place during Tuesday's  
regular trading session. The catalyst was a cluster of first-time  
analyst coverage: Guggenheim, Jefferies, TD Cowen and Evercore ISI all  
launched bullish ratings on the newly public biotech the same morning.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-lycia-therapeutics-lyca-stock-up-10-87-today-39956/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-lycia-therapeutics-lyca-stock-up-10-87-today-39956/)  
  
\*\*6. Rhythm Pharmaceuticals (RYTM)\*\* — Rhythm Pharmaceuticals jumped  
\+7.36% to $115.39 from Monday's close of $107.48, with the gain  
recorded during Tuesday's regular U.S. session. The move followed an  
unconfirmed Betaville alert circulating Tuesday that Eli Lilly  
proposed roughly $150 per share plus a contingent value right for  
Rhythm, on top of the Wall Street Journal's earlier report of a \~$10  
billion, $124-per-share AstraZeneca approach.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-rhythm-pharmaceuticals-rytm-stock-up-7-28-today-39964/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-rhythm-pharmaceuticals-rytm-stock-up-7-28-today-39964/)  
  
\*\*7. Twist Bioscience (TWST)\*\* — TWST jumped +6.00% to $111.34 from  
Monday's close of $105.04, with the move occurring entirely during  
Tuesday's regular session as shares climbed from a $102.82 low toward  
the $111.58 session high. No verified news or fundamental catalyst  
found.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-twist-bioscience-twst-stock-up-6-00-today-39987/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-twist-bioscience-twst-stock-up-6-00-today-39987/)  
  
\*\*8. Kura Oncology (KURA)\*\* — KURA jumped +5.08% to $7.45 in Tuesday's  
regular session, up $0.36 from Monday's $7.09 close, extending gains  
that began in Monday's after-hours trade. The catalyst was a Form 4  
filing disclosing that CEO Troy Wilson bought 200,000 shares worth  
roughly $1.5 million on Nov. 13 and Nov. 16, a signal of confidence  
after the recent selloff.  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-kura-oncology-kura-stock-up-5-22-today-39988/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-kura-oncology-kura-stock-up-5-22-today-39988/)  
  
\*\*9. PolyPid (PYPD)\*\* — PYPD jumped +5.37% to $6.48 from Monday's  
$6.15 close, a gain of +$0.33, with the move occurring during  
Tuesday's regular session. No verified news or fundamental catalyst  
found — no release, filing or analyst action appeared today, and the  
only scheduled event was routine one-on-one investor meetings at  
Craig-Hallum's Alpha Select Conference, so the advance is likely  
positioning ahead of the Nov 28 PDUFA...  
  
[https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-polypid-ltd-pypd-stock-up-5-37-today-39985/](https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-polypid-ltd-pypd-stock-up-5-37-today-39985/)  
  
Real breakthroughs or lottery tickets?  
  
Not financial advice. Figures are from today's (Nov 17) write-ups,  
using intraday or latest-close prices, not live quotes. Price targets  
are targets, not promises.
